meta.title: 碎花洋裙穿搭万能公式｜直接照搬给她

scenes.context: 印花开衫配白色很好看，但拉出印花里最深的颜色会更显刻意精致。白上衣换成深棕上衣，颜色来自半裙花纹中最深的部分，整体更统一。
sentences: A printed top with white looks good.
Pull the darkest color for intent.
Brown drawn from the darkest part.
paraphrase: A printed top with white looks good.
Pull the darkest color for intent.
Brown drawn from the darkest part.
scenes.speak: A printed top with white looks good. Pull the darkest color for intent. Brown drawn from the darkest part. It feels more pulled together.

scenes.context: 条纹上衣配牛仔好看，但让下装回应其中一条条纹的颜色更利落。深靛蓝牛仔裤回应上衣的深色条纹，这个技巧叫 match one stripe color。
sentences: Match the bottom to one stripe.
Indigo jeans echo the dark stripe.
It's called matching one stripe color.
paraphrase: Match the bottom to one stripe.
Indigo jeans echo the dark stripe.
It's called matching one stripe color.
scenes.speak: Stripes with denim work well. Match the bottom to one stripe. Indigo jeans echo the dark stripe. It's called matching one stripe color.

scenes.context: 格纹裤配黑色好看，但把上装与配件改成格纹里的柔和灰褐色，降低黑色带来的强对比，更显优雅精致。
sentences: Plaid trousers with black look good.
paraphrase: Plaid trousers with black look good.
scenes.speak: Plaid trousers with black look good. Soft taupe reduces harsh contrast. Soft tones ease the contrast. It looks more polished.

scenes.context: 碎花裙配中性配饰很好，但让配饰重复裙身里较深的印花色更显高级。酒红、深绿与棕灰配件分别重复裙身花纹中的较深色彩，整体更显细腻。
sentences: A floral dress with neutrals works.
Accents repeat the skirt's dark colors.
paraphrase: A floral dress with neutrals works.
Accents repeat the skirt's dark colors.
scenes.speak: A floral dress with neutrals works. Repeat one darker print color. Accents repeat the skirt's dark colors. It feels more refined.
